nonPassingRunsRetained.reason: XCTest scroll geometry became infinite with the keyboard; replaced with bounded screen coordinates.
First QA route used loopback-only 8185 rather than verified LAN proxy 8186; stopped without resetting data.
Creation and approval proofs were captured, then an exact StaticText lookup missed the virtualized task. Later actual checkbox interaction passed.
Automation queried a button rather than the native checkbox role; corrected to accessibility identifier.
Native catalog keyboard covered the edit action. Fixed Native keyboard props and corrected gesture bounds to exclude the prediction toolbar.
Automation gesture still began in the keyboard toolbar; corrected without weakening the edit/save assertions.
Same test geometry issue; successful normal navigation, exact input and later explicit drag tests recorded separately.

The first revoked-member matcher expected English permission text; actual Rules expression rejection and guarded-screen denial were subsequently asserted.
